definitions.explanation: A conversation spoken quietly or privately so that others cannot hear, or a conversation whose contents are meant to be kept secret.

examples.japanese: {内緒話|ないしょばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{内緒話|ないしょばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くすくす{笑|わら}っている→くすくす笑う：25280_kusukusuwarau⟧。
examples.english: The children are whispering secrets and giggling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{内緒話|ないしょばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was whispering with the person next to me during the meeting and got scolded by my boss.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{内緒|ないしょ}→内緒：03126_naisho⟧ (secret, private) and ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (talk, conversation). Evokes an image of people leaning close together and speaking in hushed tones. Common in everyday conversation, especially when describing children whispering or coworkers sharing gossip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内緒話|ないしょばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a secret talk
- {内緒話|ないしょばなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to overhear whispering
- ⟦{耳元|みみもと}→耳元：28311_mimimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{内緒話|ないしょばなし}: whispering in someone's ear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひそひそ→ひそひそ：06273_hisohiso⟧{話|ばなし}: whispering — emphasizes the hushed manner of speaking rather than the secret content
- ⟦{密談|みつだん}→密談：17980_mitsudan⟧: secret discussion — more formal and serious, often about plans or schemes
